_source: Doodle Labs Range Estimation Tool (kb.doodlelabs.com/range-estimation-tool), extracted via authenticated browser session July 29 2026. Model tables read directly from page JS; propagation math reverse-engineered from probe runs (see probes).

model_tables._note: power arrays are PER-CHAIN TX power (dBm) indexed by MCS pair [0/8, 1/9, 2/10, 3/11, 4/12, 5/13, 6/14, 7/15]. Combined output with 2 antennas = +3 dB. sensitivity arrays are dBm at 20 MHz for MCS0-7; MCS8-15 = value + 3 dB (worse). All models share the same sensitivity curve; only TX power differs.

reverse_engineered_model.allowed_path_loss_db: tx_combined + tx_gain + rx_gain + bda_gain - attenuation - fade_margin - sensitivity
reverse_engineered_model.range_normal_mode: pure FSPL inversion: d_km = 10^((PL - 32.45 - 20*log10(f_MHz))/20). Antenna heights are COMPLETELY IGNORED (no two-ray, no horizon cap - 1 m antennas can 'reach' 387 km).
reverse_engineered_model.range_ground_mode: empirical steeper model, exact formula not extracted (DLP blocked code text). Constant 22.25 dB/decade distance slope at fixed frequency; frequency dependence is NOT a simple 20logf term (see probes). Heights ignored here too.
reverse_engineered_model.verified_exact_matches: FSPL mode reproduces tool output to the meter across bw (10/20/40), power clamps, attenuation, BDA gain, 1 vs 2 antennas.

probes._note: All at telemetry=250kbps, video=3Mbps, txGain=3, rxGain=3, fade=10, atten=0, bda=0 unless stated. Entries: [mcs, range_m, max_mbps].

ground_mode_freq_sweep_miniOEM_v4_budget._note: 915 value used 2L v3 radio (budget 110); others 2L_v4 budget 112

discrepancy_vs_datasheets: Estimator sensitivities (-87..-69 MCS0-7 @20MHz) are ~6 dB MORE CONSERVATIVE than published datasheet sensitivities (-93..-75 for 2x2 mini-OEM). Estimator TX powers are per-chain and lower than datasheet 'combined' figures. The estimator is the sales-facing conservative reference; datasheets are the optimistic lab reference. Simulator should default to estimator-grade numbers with a toggle.
